description: Election Commission - Mr. M. L. P. Jeramius Pulle of the Katana Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Katana Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a notice issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the status of an elected official, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
